experiment_data.notes: DocRED semantic-only 完成。DR 18.46%→15.05% (-3.41pp, ↓18.5%)。但 ET 暴涨 8.18%→18.44% (+10.26pp)——TypeConstraintProcessor 干扰 relation 字段 entity type token 生成，产生畸形类型(PERSON/带前导空格/截断)。RV 不变(29.87%)。F1 无变化。结论：semantic 层单独使用时 DR 有效但引入 ET 副作用，必须配合 grammar 层消除 ET/RV 并防止 type 畸变。强化 ablation story。998 lines, 0 duplicates。

comparison_vs_unconstrained.note: DR improves slightly (-3.41pp) but ET explodes (+10.26pp) due to TypeConstraintProcessor interfering with entity type tokens in relation fields. Confirms grammar layer is essential to prevent ET side effects.
